geometry.derivation: v18 geometry-force attribution placed v1 shelf contacts at world z 0.765-0.772 m and source finger contacts at 0.785-0.790 m; the wrist-pose local-z projection onto world-z is 0.819, so a +0.020 m local-z translation raises the shelf contact band by about 0.0164 m while keeping size, local x/y, and the v11 motion protocol fixed
